verification_note: All sources cited as canonical primary literature (peer-reviewed / arXiv). Full-text re-fetch not performed in this environment; provenance marked accordingly.

records.source: S. Laporta, E. Remiddi, Phys. Lett. B 379, 283 (1996)
D. Hanneke, S. Fogwell, G. Gabrielse, Phys. Rev. Lett. 100, 120801 (2008)
R. Bouchendira et al., Phys. Rev. Lett. 106, 080801 (2011)
records.claim: alpha from atom interferometry, independent of g-2

records.source: E. Joos, D. Zeh, Z. Phys. B 59, 223 (1985)
records.claim: reduced coherence suppression under environmental coupling

records.source: W. H. Zurek, Phys. Rev. D 26, 1862 (1982); Phys. Rev. D 24, 1516 (1981)
W. H. Zurek, Rev. Mod. Phys. 75, 715 (2003)
records.claim: decoherence selects pointer states; outcome problem explicitly NOT solved by decoherence alone

records.source: H. Everett III, Rev. Mod. Phys. 29, 454 (1957)
D. Deutsch, Proc. R. Soc. A 455, 3123 (1999); D. Wallace, 'The Emergent Multiverse' (2012)
records.claim: decision-theoretic derivation of Born weights from rationality axioms

records.source: W. H. Zurek, Phys. Rev. Lett. 106, 250402 (2011)
T. Maudlin, in 'Many Worlds?' (2010); A. Kent, Int. J. Mod. Phys. A 5, 1745 (1990)
records.claim: critiques: derivations rely on nontrivial assumptions (additivity, decision continuity, preferred factorization); Everett does not yield Born rule unaided

records.source: G. Ghirardi, A. Rimini, T. Weber, Phys. Rev. D 34, 470 (1986)
records.claim: spontaneous localization process with hit rate lambda and localization width a

records.source: G. Ghirardi, P. Pearle, A. Rimini, Phys. Rev. A 42, 78 (1990)
records.claim: continuous spontaneous localization (CSL), relativistic-consistent stochastic master equation

records.source: S. Weinberg, E. Witten, Phys. Rev. Lett. 44, 1171 (1980)
records.claim: theorems: (1) a theory with a Lorentz-covariant conserved local 4-index current containing the energy-momentum tensor cannot have massless particles of spin j > 1/2 with nonvanishing standard energy; (2) a Lorentz-invariant QFT with well-defined Lorentz-covariant T^{mu nu} cannot have massless spin-2 particles with nonvanishing momentum

records.source: J. de Alcantara Bonfim, G. Shore, Ann. Phys. (1991); and various responses (e.g. 't Hooft-type emergent frameworks, Bjorken, Volovik)
records.claim: scope questions: composite gravitons, emergent gravity in non-Lorentz-invariant or condensed-matter-like constructions evade the assumptions

records.source: J. Gasser, H. Leutwyler, Ann. Phys. 158, 142 (1984); Nucl. Phys. B 250, 465 (1985)
records.claim: one-loop ChPT: pion mass relation m_pi^2 = M^2[1 - (M^2/F^2)(L-bar log M^2 + k_pi)] with L-bar = ln(mu^2/M^2)

records.source: G. Colangelo, J. Gasser, H. Leutwyler, Nucl. Phys. B 603, 125 (2001)
records.claim: pi-pi scattering lengths predicted at two loops with error estimate; later confirmed by experiment

records.source: S. R. Beane et al. (NPLQCD), Phys. Rev. D 77, 014505 (2008) / DIRAC experiment (Phys. Lett. B 619, 70, 2005)
records.claim: lattice/experimental determination consistent with ChPT pi-pi scattering prediction
